title: Cost
intro: What the cluster costs, as OpenCost or Kubecost computes it. Read-only: nothing is changed in the cluster.

notFound.title: OpenCost or Kubecost was not found
notFound.text: Costs are shown when OpenCost (https://www.opencost.io) or Kubecost runs in the cluster. Sextant looks for its Service in the opencost and kubecost namespaces and by the label app.kubernetes.io/name. Sextant does not install it.

labelKey.label: Label key
labelKey.invalid: This is not a label key.
labelKey.choose: Enter a label key, such as app.kubernetes.io/name, and choose Show.

idleHint: Idle is the cost of node capacity no workload used. It belongs to the whole cluster, also when namespaces are filtered.
currencyUnknown: Amounts are in the currency OpenCost or Kubecost is configured with; the API does not name it.
efficiencyHint: Efficiency is usage divided by requests.
filtered: Only the selected namespaces are shown.
truncated_one: Only the {{count}} most expensive group is shown, of {{total}}.
truncated_other: Only the {{count}} most expensive groups are shown, of {{total}}.

details.title: Cost
details.monthlyHint: An estimate: the cost of the last 7 days (or of the time the workload ran in them) scaled to 30 days.
details.prices: Unit prices from this workload's costs: {{cpu}} per CPU core-hour, {{memory}} per GiB-hour of memory.
details.noData: OpenCost or Kubecost has no costs for this workload in the last 7 days.
details.savings: Estimated savings with the right-sizing recommendation
details.savingsHint: An estimate: requests above the recommendation, over all replicas, times this workload's unit prices, over 30 days.
details.noSavings: The right-sizing recommendation does not lower the requests, so it saves nothing.
details.noPrices: The costs carry no unit price for a resource the recommendation lowers, so savings cannot be estimated.
